history.note: harness until the mode-cutoff restart (borg-zoo#54). The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.name: reborn-heal-r100-curves-pilot
experiment.owner_authorization: 2026-11-17: after the big tier of reserve {0, 100, 200} x curve {50, 75} on e0aa2e0a (run 44148205941, where r100-c50 had the fewest deaths), the owner asked to keep reserve 100 fixed and run curve 50, 75, 100, 125, 150 as a pilot, on the current build (main dd5f026e).
experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-17, before any result was read (borg-zoo#192). Pilot (RULES 16) on main dd5f026e; more starts
only after this gate and the owner. Gate: no config_error; one binary; the three borg_param_town_heal_*
lines (reserve 100, the arm's curve, speed 66) in every borg.txt and in params-core.json of the death
replays; no plan loaded; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; frozen-turn bursts classified;
death bundles reproduced. Consistency: r100-c100, r100-c125 and r100-c150 are reborn-heal-light-pilot's arms
of the same names (borg-zoo#219, same specimen and starts) and must replay its key hashes. Report per arm:
deaths, final level, deepest level, paired rescued and newly killed against r100-c50. Context, not pooled:
on e0aa2e0a (a different build), r100-c50 had 44 deaths of 540 on starts 361-900. 18 starts per arm show
direction only.
